question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank No. 1.
solution:
Here the correct answer is **About**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate option to** fill in the blank No. 1 **is:** about.**
 
• The phrase** "stories about" **is commonly used to indicate that the stories are related to or concerning a particular subject. In this case, the passage is discussing other stories related to Krishna.
 
 
• Example: "There were many **stories about** the bravery of the knight."
 
• In this example, "stories about" indicates that the stories discussed are connected to the bravery of the knight.
 
 
 
• In summary, the most appropriate option to **fill in the blank No. 1** is** "about"** as it indicates that the stories mentioned in the passage are related to Krishna.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Other options:
 
• **upon**: This preposition implies physical contact or close proximity and does not fit the context of the sentence.
 
 
• Example: "She stumbled upon a hidden treasure."
 
• In this example, "upon" indicates the accidental discovery of the treasure.
 
 
 
• **with respect:** This phrase is used to indicate consideration or regard for someone or something and does not fit the context of the sentence.
 
 
• Example: "Please treat the matter with respect."
 
• In this example, "with respect" emphasizes the importance of treating the matter in a respectful manner.
 
 
 
• **belonging to**: This phrase implies ownership or possession and does not fit the context of the sentence.
 
 
• Example: "The book belongs to me."
 
• In this example, "belonging to" indicates the ownership of the book.
